sloka: यथा वक्ष्यसि धर्मज्ञ तत् करिष्यामहे वयम् ।तत् धर्मिष्ठम् यशस्यम् च वचनम् सत्य वादिनः ॥१-६९-१५॥
transliteration: yathā vakṣyasi dharmajña tat kariṣyāmahe vayam ।tat dharmiṣṭham yaśasyam ca vacanam satya vādinaḥ ॥1-69-15॥

translations.english: Janaka was filled with extreme admiration to hear one who was truthful, righteous and famous (this Dasaratha).
